country.evidence_quote: Welcome to S & H Independent Premium Brands EAST, the nationwide importer of fine lagers and ales from Europe. Our company has a rich history, founded by Irene Wagner, whose family has been importing Munich's finest brews into the United States since the early 1960s. With over 35 years of experience in the beverage business, Shawn Rich and Fran Cattani have assembled a portfolio of some of the world's most renowned European brews. Our commitment to product quality and superiority is unparalleled
